TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_RABBIT.title: Bare White Rabbit of Good Fortune
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_RABBIT.description: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Randomize the cost of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn, if a card cost [blue]0[/blue] add [gold]Replay[/gold] to it this combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SATORI_EYE.title: Satori's 3rd Eye
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SATORI_EYE.description:
[gold]Scry[/gold] [blue]{SatoriScry}[/blue].
Return this to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Increase the cost of this card by {Energy:energyIcons()} this turn.
[purple][jitter]Now, this is where it truly begins![/jitter][/purple]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TRIBUTE.title: Tribute
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TRIBUTE.description:
After donating [blue]{Remaining}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], this is removed from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
[fade_in]I'm adorable so give me money![/fade_in]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_SEAL.title: Dream Seal
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_SEAL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage [blue]6[/blue] times to ALL enemies.
If an enemy intents to Attack, Apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], it loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
[b]Extermination, decided.[/b]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_SAKUYA.title: Servant of Time
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_SAKUYA.descriptio:
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the end of this turn, for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to the target.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_PATCHOULI.title: Servant of Magic
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_PATCHOULI.descrip:
Add [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to all non-Servant cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add {Cards} [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_HONGMEILING.title: Servant of Qi
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SERVANT_HONGMEILING.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to half the Attack damage prevented by [gold]Block[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ALL_CREATION_HISOU.title: Heaven of Scarlet Perception for All Humankind
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ALL_CREATION_HISOU.descri:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgrade[/gold], |}Play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
[red]The weather in the sky, the stability of the earth, and the temperament of man　are all in the palm of my hand![/red]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ALL_CREATION_HISOU_OLD.de:
本场战斗所有队友已拥有与之后获得的[gold]正面效果[/gold]层数增加[blue]1[/blue]。
所有队友获得{Energy:energyIcons()}、{singleStarIcon}。抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。[gold]铸造[/gold][blue]9[/blue]。[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]5[/blue]。获得[blue]1[/blue][gold]力量[/gold]、[blue]1[/blue][gold]敏捷[/gold]、[blue]1[/blue][gold]集中[/gold]。
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_WALLET.title: Magic of the Mallet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_WALLET.description:
Your next [blue]{CurrentFreeCount}[/blue] other cards are free to play.
Each time this card is played, its cost increases by {Energy:energyIcons()} and the number of free plays increases by [blue]1[/blue].
[purple][sine]Sound a requiem for the traitors![/sine][/purple]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL.title: Lily　of the Valley
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards} cards. Apply {PoisonSelf} [gold]Poison[/gold] to yourself.
At end of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies, increase the Energy gained by {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, and increase the [gold]Poison[/gold] applied to yourself by [blue]1[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LIFE_MUST_PERISH.title: All Life Must Perish
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LIFE_MUST_PERISH.descript:
After {Countdown:inverseDiff()} turns, remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] from ALL enemies and apply [blue]9999[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold].
When you receive attack damage, extend the countdown by [blue]1[/blue] turn and apply [blue]{SelfDoom}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KONSHII_NO_KUSURI_CARD.de:
When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], if this card is in your hand, discard it and heal [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP instead. Increase [pink]Impurity[/pink] by [blue]1[/blue], then lose [blue]{BaseMaxHpLoss}[/blue] × [pink]Impurity[/pink] Max HP.{InCombat:
([red]{ShouldLose}[/red] Max HP will be lost.)|}
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MASTER_SPARK.title: Master Spark
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MASTER_SPARK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X+{ExtraHit} times.
If X is {Need:diff()} or more, {IfUpgraded:show:triple|double} X and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[gold]Danmaku is all about firepower[sine]Da☆Ze[/sine]![/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEA_OPENING_MIRACLE.title: Miracle of the Sea Opening
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEA_OPENING_MIRACLE.descr: Deal damage to each enemy equal to half of that enemy's current HP.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_KOISHI_EYE.title: The Closed Eye
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_KOISHI_EYE.descriptio:
Randomly play {Cards:diff()} cards from your [gold]draw pile[/gold], [gold]hand[/gold], and [gold]discard pile[/gold].
A random Attack among them gain [purple]Instinct[/purple].
Add [red]Unconscious[/red] to 1 random card among them.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KILLING_AURA.title: Killing Aura
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KILLING_AURA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a card with Damage or Block, if this card is in your [gold]hand[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it and add its Damage and Block{IfUpgraded:show:, increased by 1|} to this card.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_HELL_OF_BULLETS.desc:
Choose any number of cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Transform[/gold] them into [gold]Nameless Danmaku[/gold].
This turn, your Attack cards cost 0{Energy:energyIcons()} and draw 1 card when played. When you have no Attack cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], end your turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NAMELESS_BULLETS.title: Nameless Danmaku
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RICHEST_FORM.title: Opulent Form
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RICHEST_FORM.description:
Gain [blue]{StartingCapital:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Funds[/gold].
Playing non X-cost cards no longer consumes Energy. Instead, they consume [gold]Funds[/gold] at a [blue]1:10[/blue] ratio. If you do not have enough [gold]Funds[/gold], spend the same amount of [gold]Gold[/gold] instead.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POOREST_FORM.title: Destitute Form
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POOREST_FORM.description:
Whenever you play a card that costs [blue]0[/blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}, or end your turn with [blue]0[/blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}, apply one of the following at random to a random enemy:
[blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] / [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] / [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] / [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_FEAST.title: Frenzied Feast
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_FEAST.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] {MinExhaust}~{MaxExhaust} non-[gold]Frenzied Feast[/gold] cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. For each card Exhausted, gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {Energy:energyIcons()}.
At the end of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add {Copies} copies of this card to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
